environment.description: Docker container running on ECS Fargate with default configuration. Container image based on python:3.11-slim, running as non-root user (uid 1000). Service exposed via Application Load Balancer on port 8080. Container has read-write filesystem with /tmp and /var/log/docproc mounted as writable volumes. Network egress allowed to all destinations. No XML-specific request filtering configured on the ALB.
